title: Man. Post. Cap. X: Opponent subsumes — Adam’s first sin is that pre-law sin of the prior verse
pass_a_gloss: Next you fold in the minor: Adam first-sin equals the sin named in the verse just before, the point you say was already proved above.
pass_b_english: You subsume: but the first sin of Adam was that sin of which the Apostle spoke in the immediately preceding verse, as we proved above.
source_text: Subsumis, sed peccatum primum Adami fuit illud peccatum de quo locutus est Apostolus versu immediate praecedenti, ut supra probavimus.

choices.choice: Opponent: Adam’s first sin = that prior-verse sin

notes: Cap. X Rom.5.13 densify section 661 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 357–359 tip).
